'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*Spillover of the [[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[Saudi Arabian–led intervention in Yemen]]
***The [[United Arab Emirates Armed Forces]] intercepts two [[ballistic missile]]s over the [[United Arab Emirates|Emirati]] capital [[Abu Dhabi]]. The [[Yemen]]-based [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] claim responsibility for the attack. [[American troops]] stationed at [[Al Dhafra Air Base]] near the capital take shelter in [[Air raid shelter|bunkers]] during the attack. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/uae-intercepts-ballistic-missilles-abu-dhabi-82432668 (ABC News)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]], [[Ukraine–United Kingdom relations]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] begins withdrawing staff and their dependants from [[Embassy of the United Kingdom, Kyiv|its embassy]] in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], amid fears of a [[Russia]]n invasion. Around half of all staff are being withdrawn, according to a statement from the [[Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office|Foreign Office]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/24/uk-pulls-some-embassy-staff-from-ukraine-amid-russian-threat (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Ethnic violence in South Sudan]]
**At least 31 ethnic [[Dinka people|Dinka]] people are killed in clashes with suspected [[Murle people|Murle]] armed youth in [[Jonglei State]], [[South Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-south-sudan-9c56c8439eeb6a0ea4edc1625ac4c6b8 (AP)]
*[[January 2022 Burkina Faso coup d'état|2022 Burkinabé coup d'état]]
**[[Burkina Faso Armed Forces|Troops]] detain [[List of heads of state of Burkina Faso|President]] [[Roch Marc Christian Kaboré]] amid reports of gunfire overnight in the capital [[Ouagadougou]]. Access to the internet has reportedly been disrupted nationwide. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-60109234 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tropical Storm Ana (2022)|Tropical Storm Ana]]
**[[Tropical Storm]] Ana kills 23 people in [[Madagascar]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-01-24/tropical-storm-ana-floods-madagascar-s-capital-34-dead (Bloomberg)]
*[[Yaoundé stadium disaster]]
**Eight people are killed in a [[crowd crush]] at [[Olembe Stadium]] in [[Yaoundé]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/01/24/africa/cameroon-stadium-collapse-intl-afr (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****A [[COVID-19]] vaccine pass that requires people over the age of 16 years to be fully [[COVID-19 vaccination in France|vaccinated]] or show proof of recovery in order to enter bars, restaurants, and other public spaces, and to use inter-regional transport takes effect in [[France]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/01/24/covid-19-france-s-vaccine-pass-enters-into-force-amid-omicron-surge (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 65,109 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 11,173,300. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/01/24/russia-sees-4th-consecutive-record-number-of-covid-cases-a76128 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****Former [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Mariano Rajoy]] tests positive for COVID-19 for the second time. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/sociedad/20220124/rajoy-positivo-covid-19-suspende-13141406 (''El Periódico'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia]]
***The [[Australian Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation]] gives the final approval for use of the [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine]] for people over the age of 18 years. The rollout of the vaccine will begin on February 21. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-01-24/novavax-covid-vaccine-atagi-approval-rollout-february/100777186 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[China]] lifts its lockdown for 13 million people in [[Xi'an]] as the number of COVID-19 infections decreases in the city. [https://apnews.com/article/winter-olympics-coronavirus-pandemic-sports-travel-health-63e4ebc0a67c939bf020c93cd715297a (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
***[[Egypt]]'s drug regulator issues an emergency use authorization for [[Merck & Co.|Merck]]'s [[Molnupiravir]] anti-COVID-19 drug. [https://apnews.com/article/winter-olympics-coronavirus-pandemic-sports-travel-health-63e4ebc0a67c939bf020c93cd715297a (Ahram Online)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Heidelberg University shooting]]
**A [[mass shooting]] occurs in a lecture hall at the [[New Campus (Heidelberg University)|New Campus]] of the [[University of Heidelberg]] in [[Neuenheimer Feld]], [[Heidelberg]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. A woman is killed and three other people are injured before the gunman commits [[suicide]]. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/heidelberg-university-attack-germany-police-lone-attacker-students-injured-b978435.html (''Evening Standard'')]
*A fire at a nightclub in [[Sorong]], [[West Papua (province)|West Papua]], [[Indonesia]], following an armed clash between two groups, kills at least 18 people. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220125-at-least-18-dead-after-clash-fire-at-club-in-indonesia-s-west-papua-police (AFP via France 24)]
*[[National Commission on Human Rights (Indonesia)|Indonesian National Commission on Human Rights]] suspects former Regent of Langkat, a regency in Sumatra, Indonesia, of practicing [[modern slavery]] after [[Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi|KPK]], in a [[sting operation]], finds a jail-like facility to house the workers. [https://en.tempo.co/read/1553466/former-langkat-regent-suspected-of-corruption-slavery (Tempo English)]
 
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Italian presidential election]]
**Voting for the election of the [[President of the Italian Republic]] begins, with the process expected to take multiple days. [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2022/01/24/quirinale-parte-la-corsa-al-colle_71d80569-8826-4e0c-b7c6-568eea56a6c0.html (ANSA)]
**In the first round of voting, two-thirds of electors cast blank ballots. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/01/25/italian-lawmakers-cast-mostly-blank-ballots-in-1st-round-of-presidential-election (Euronews)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[James Webb Space Telescope]], a collaboration among [[NASA]], the [[European Space Agency]], and the [[Canadian Space Agency]], successfully enters orbit at its target destination, located near the Sun–Earth L<sub>2</sub> [[Lagrange point]] about {{convert|1.5|e6km|mi|sp=us}} from Earth. [https://manilastandard.net/news/314173247/webb-telescope-reaches-final-destination-a-million-miles-from-earth.html (AFP via ''Manila Standard'')]
*The [[two-stage rocket|second stage]] of the [[Falcon 9 v1.1]] used to launch the [[Deep Space Climate Observatory]] in 2015 is projected to [[impact event|impact]] the [[Moon]] on March 4, 2022. [https://arstechnica.com/science/2022/01/an-old-falcon-9-rocket-may-strike-the-moon-within-weeks/ (arsTECHNICA)]
